The infant mortality rate is the number of infant (aged <1 year) deaths per 1,000 live births.
In 2016, the infant mortality rate in the United States was 5.87 infant deaths per 1,000 live births.
The rate ranged from 3.47 in Vermont to 9.03 in Alabama.
Higher rates were primarily in the southern states.
Source: National Vital Statistics System. Linked birth/infant death period files, 2016.
